# Mitishell v1.3.0

Launcher QoL and feature updates! Plus clipboard history and bug fixes.

## New Features

> [!NOTE]  
> New launcher features can be bound to a hotkey.

- `mitishell launcher` records clipboard copies. Queries beginning with `:` search the history, activating an entry copies it again and moves it to the top, Delete removes the selected entry, and a clear action wipes the stored file. Copies from any application are recorded while the history is enabled.
- Clipboard history is configurable in Settings > System or through `mitishell config`: it can be turned off entirely or capped between 5 and 100 entries. Turning it off clears the stored history.
- Queries beginning with `>` run shell commands through `sh -c`.
- In an active UWSM session, most launched applications and run commands start in their own systemd scope through `uwsm app`.
- Launcher selection now wraps from end to end, and searches return at most 30 results.
- Typing `clipboard` in the launcher opens the clipboard view directly.

## Fixes

- Incomplete calculator input such as `=` or `2 +` shows a muted hint instead of an error.
- Dragging a widget onto an earlier position in the Settings bar editor now places it at the pointer instead of appending it to the end.
- The workspace strip drops its trailing divider and gains a wider gap before the window title.
- The overflow button matches the other bar islands, and its menu sizes to its contents.

## Install

Download the archive matching your system and `SHA256SUMS` from this release. Then run:

```bash
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing
tar -xzf mitishell-v1.3.0-linux-amd64.tar.gz    # or mitishell-v1.3.0-linux-arm64.tar.gz
cd mitishell-v1.3.0-linux-amd64
make install-prebuilt
quickshell -n -p ~/.local/share/mitishell/shell
```
